attributes.action: Stop all UK funding for Ukraine and spend it on the UK
attributes.additional_details: We call on the UK Government to stop all military and financial funding for Ukraine. The UK has sent billions abroad while NHS waiting lists, housing, schools, social care, pensions and the cost of living remain urgent at home. We want a full public audit of all aid sent, a parliamentary vote before new money, and future spending redirected to UK services and taxpayers. We support diplomacy and ceasefire talks, but oppose open-ended blank cheques without public consent. Put the UK first.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to stop all military and financial funding for Ukraine. The money should go to our own country instead — NHS, housing, schools, pensions and cost of living. No more blank cheques. Put the UK first.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Pause military support for Ukraine and hold a referendum" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781311
